mobbin:157d0155-3762-4ce7-81c3-aead25729.summary: From a board's 'Subscribe' pop-up, the user creates a weekly subscription with a day, time, time zone and a recipient found by search.
steps: Subscribe pop-up: Email/Slack empty, Create New
Create Subscription window: schedule and timezone
Weekly selected, with day and time pickers
Add subscriber: name and email search
steal: 'Subscribe' sits on the board next to 'Share', so you subscribe to the view you are looking at (screen 1).
Email and Slack are tabs in the same window, so choosing a channel needs no separate steps (screens 2 to 5).
'Send Test' sits next to the subscriber list, so you can check the digest before it goes live (screens 2 to 5).
When there are no subscriptions, the screen says 'No email subscriptions found for this board' and offers 'Create New' (screen 1).
avoid: Day, time and time zone must all be set before anything is sent, with no default, which works against ready-made weekly digests for deans (screens 2 to 3).
mobbin:157d0155-3762-4ce7-81c3-aead25729.fit: Reports: subscribing from the board becomes an automatic weekly or monthly email for deans. It adds to today's reports, which are pulled by hand, without a report builder.

mobbin:5d067428-a757-489e-83a9-b33e2d63e.summary: The user builds an analysis with two measures, split by device type and user group, then chooses which groups show in the chart and table.
steps: Analysis: two measures, table by device and group
Checkboxes to show or hide groups
Chart with several lines and the nested table back
steal: Rows nest by measure, then device type, then group, with an average and a column per day, so groups can be compared in one grid (screens 1 to 4).
Coloured checkboxes in the table also control the chart lines, so one control updates both views (screens 2 to 4).
Labels in the query panel name each split, such as device type or group, instead of hiding them in filters (screens 1 to 4).
avoid: A full query builder (measures, filters, splits) as the first version goes against the plan to ship ready-made defaults rather than deep builders (screens 1 to 4).
mobbin:5d067428-a757-489e-83a9-b33e2d63e.fit: Reports: this maps to comparing groups by course, year and learner in Performance Matrix and Group Performance. Essentials should ship it as ready-made views, not a free-form analysis tool.

mobbin:09f6e5da-eaa5-4633-9a33-231f80031.summary: From a chart, the user turns on a comparison with the previous period and sees 'Past Avg' columns with the change shown as green or red percentages.
steps: Insights day view with breakdown table
Hour or Yesterday range on chart
Compare menu: Time Period, Segment, % Overall
Time Period presets: previous day, 7d, 30d, year
Compare to previous day on, with Past Avg columns
Table shows colour percent change versus prior period
steal: The 'Compare' menu separates 'Time Period', 'Segment' and '% Overall', so comparing periods and comparing groups are not mixed in one control (screens 3 to 4).
Presets for the previous day, 7 days, 30 days, 3 months and a year, plus a custom option, cover most comparisons without picking dates (screen 4).
A 'Compare to previous day' label, 'Past Avg' columns and percentage changes show what moved at a glance (screens 5 to 6).
mobbin:09f6e5da-eaa5-4633-9a33-231f80031.fit: Reports: compare this period with the last for room use and for faculty or learner headline numbers. It extends Performance Matrix, but does not help with accreditation packs.
